definitions.gloss: fiercely; furiously; with great force or intensity
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something with fierce intensity, violent energy, or unstoppable force. Often used with と as {猛然|もうぜん}と.

examples.japanese: {猛然|もうぜん}と{走|はし}り{出|だ}した。
{猛然|もうぜん}と{抗議|こうぎ}した。
{犬|いぬ}が{猛然|もうぜん}と{侵入者|しんにゅうしゃ}に{飛|と}びかかった。
examples.english: The dog leaped at the intruder with fierce intensity.

notes:
Composed of {猛|もう} (fierce, ferocious) + {然|ぜん} (in such a manner). Almost always used in the form {猛然|もうぜん}と, with the particle と marking it as an adverb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猛然|もうぜん}と{立|た}ち{向|む}かう: to stand up against fiercely
- {猛然|もうぜん}と{反論|はんろん}する: to argue back furiously
- {猛然|もうぜん}と{走|はし}る: to run furiously
- {猛然|もうぜん}と{襲|おそ}いかかる: to attack ferociously

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {激|はげ}しく: intensely, violently — more common in everyday speech
- {猛烈|もうれつ}に: fiercely, intensely — similar intensity but used as a na-adjective stem
- {果敢|かかん}に: boldly, daringly — emphasizes courage rather than raw force
